summary: Ituran Location and Control Ltd. filed a Form 6-K on August 12, 2026, reporting Q2 2026 earnings. Revenue reached $104.8 million (up 21% YoY), net income was $17.3 million, and EBITDA was $28.5 million. The company added 41,000 net subscribers, and the board declared a quarterly dividend of $10 million ($0.50 per share). This is a routine earnings release with a standard dividend declaration, not a special-situations event. No M&A, activist, or restructuring activity is present. Watch for continued subscriber growth and dividend consistency.
